cli.description: Habit Coach: log what really happened, see how closely you followed the plan, review the plan every Sunday.

arg.text: What you did, in your own words
arg.kind: start, done, skip or note (default: start with --habit, otherwise note)
arg.tiny: Only the tiny version was done
arg.excused: The skip is rest, illness or travel, not a lapse
arg.id: Event id shown when it was logged
arg.apply: Write the proposed changes as next week's plan
arg.from: First day the version applies, YYYY-MM-DD
arg.weeks: How many weeks to export (default: from the profile)
arg.format: ics file, or json on stdout

cmd.log: Record an activity: what you actually did, and when
cmd.void: Cancel a log entry by its id
cmd.today: Today's plan, progress and a nudge
cmd.review: Sunday review: the report plus proposed plan changes
cmd.plan: Show, check or version the weekly plan
cmd.plan_check: Validate the plan and list advice
cmd.plan_new_version: Start a new plan version from a date (archives the old one)
cmd.ics: Export the plan as a Google Calendar .ics file, or as JSON
cmd.nudge: A reminder or a word of motivation for right now

err.bad_week: '{value}' is not an ISO week (use YYYY-Www, e.g. 2026-W41).
err.tiny_kind: --tiny only applies to start and done.
err.future_time: {value} is in the future. For an earlier day, add --date YYYY-MM-DD.
err.unknown_habit: Unknown habit '{habit}'. Habits in the plan that day: {habits}.
err.no_such_event: No event [{id}] in the last two weeks (pass --date to search elsewhere).
err.version_not_later: Plan not written: the current plan already starts on {current}, and a new version must start later (asked for {requested}).
err.bad_weeks: --weeks must be a whole number from 1 to {max}.

status.pending_due: time to start — message me when you do
status.pending_overdue: past the start time — still doable
status.pending_passed: past its window — it still counts if you do it today, at a lower score

today.no_plan: No plan yet. Tell Claude your goals and your typical day, and it will build your week.
today.review_due: 📝 The weekly review for {week} is due — ask Claude to run it.

report.title: Week {week} ({start} – {end})
report.no_data: No scored data this week yet.
report.counts: Done {done} of {counted} · on time {on_time} · pending {pending} · excused {excused}

proposal.reduce_duration: {habit}: only {done} of {planned} done. Shrink it from {old} to {new} minutes so it is easy to start.
proposal.drop_day: {habit}: still only {done} of {planned} done at this size. Drop {day} and keep the days that work.
proposal.shift_time: {habit}: you really do it around {new}, not {old}. Move the plan to match your real routine.
proposal.level_up: {habit}: {weeks} strong weeks in a row. Raise it from {old} to {new} minutes.
proposal.flag: {habit}: only {done} of {planned} done and it cannot shrink further. Let's talk about whether it still fits.

review.no_changes: No plan changes needed. Keep going as you are.
review.deferred_title: Held back for later (a few edits a week is plenty):
review.notes_placeholder:
## Notes from Claude

(Claude writes the analysis, the encouragement and what changed here.)
review.nothing_to_apply: Nothing to apply: no proposal changes the plan.
review.applied: Applied {count} change(s): the new plan is effective {date}. The old version is archived in plan/history/.

plan.new_version: New plan version effective {date}: edit {path}, then run `python3 habit.py ics`.

warn.too_many: {count} scored habits. More than {max} rarely survive a month; consider fewer.
warn.no_anchor: {habit}: no anchor yet. Which existing routine does it follow?
warn.no_tiny: {habit}: no tiny version for the bad days.

ics.written: Wrote {count} events ({weeks} week(s) from {first}) to {path}. Import it into Google Calendar (Settings → Import & export).

nudge.identity_default: I keep the promises I make to myself
nudge.why_default: to feel in control of my days

comeback.0: Missed {habit} yesterday? That is fine, one miss is an accident. Today just do the tiny version: {tiny}
comeback.1: Never miss twice. {habit} is due again today, and even {tiny} keeps the chain alive.
comeback.2: Yesterday is gone and today is open. Start {habit} small ({tiny}) and you are back on track.

pre.0: It is almost time for {habit}. Start with the tiny version: {tiny}.
pre.1: Next up: {habit}. Do not plan the whole thing, just {tiny}, then see how you feel.
pre.2: {habit} is coming up. Message me the moment you start and I will log it.

milestone.0: {streak} in a row for {habit}! Every repetition is a vote for the person you are becoming: {identity}.
milestone.1: Streak of {streak} for {habit}. The chain is getting hard to break, so protect it tomorrow.
milestone.2: {streak}! That is no longer luck, it is a habit forming. {habit} is becoming part of you.

done.0: Logged. {done} of {total} done today ({pct}%). Keep the momentum.
done.1: Nice, {habit} is done. That is one more vote for: {identity}.
done.2: Done beats perfect. {habit} counts, and it is {streak} in a row.

evening.0: Evening check: {done} of {total} done today ({pct}%). {remaining} still open, and even the tiny version counts.
evening.1: Before the day ends: {done} of {total} done. If something is still open, pick the easiest one and do just two minutes.
evening.2: Today's score: {pct}%. Whatever it is, tomorrow starts fresh, and logging honestly is already a win.

morning.0: Good morning! {total} items on today's plan. Remember why you started: {why}
morning.1: A new day. You are someone who says: {identity}. Take the first small step.
morning.2: {total} items today. Do not aim for perfect, aim for showing up.

sunday.0: This week you followed {pct}% of your plan. Let's make next week easier to keep.
sunday.1: Week's end: {pct}%. Progress is the goal, not perfection. I will fit the plan to your real life.
sunday.2: Sunday review time. {pct}% this week: let's look at what worked and what to simplify.

generic.1: {identity}. One small action today proves it.
generic.2: Small steps, repeated, beat big plans. What is the next tiny step?
